description: This file defines a ResponseWriter struct and an AsyncResponseWriter struct for asynchronously writing and streaming data to a client in a web server context, using actix_web, tokio, and mpsc channels.

classes.name: ResponseWriter
classes.description: A buffered asynchronous writer that sends data to a client via an mpsc channel, supporting flush and error handling.

classes.name: AsyncResponseWriter
classes.description: An asynchronous wrapper around ResponseWriter implementing tokio::io::AsyncWrite for non-blocking streaming.

methods.name: ResponseWriter::new
methods.description: Creates a new ResponseWriter with a given response byte sender.

methods.name: ResponseWriter::close_with_error
methods.description: Flushes data and sends an error message to the client if flushing fails.

methods.name: ResponseWriter::async_flush
methods.description: Asynchronously flushes the buffer to the client.

methods.name: ResponseWriter::write
methods.description: Writes data to the internal buffer.

methods.name: ResponseWriter::flush
methods.description: Flushes the buffer to the client via the response channel.

methods.name: AsyncResponseWriter::new
methods.description: Creates a new AsyncResponseWriter wrapping a ResponseWriter.
